bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost $680, nearing the 100 and 200-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 $680，逼近 100 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Meta fell 7.0% on Oct 22 to $648.85, trading between $639.69 and $681.07 on twice its average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($691.1) and 10-day ($715.4) and rising 30-day ($715.6), and above the rising 100-day ($630.4) and 200-day ($632.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 but is above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($756.87), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Meta 10月22日下跌 7.0%，收于 $648.85，盘中区间 $639.69–681.07，成交量约为平均水平的两倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$691.1）和 10 日（$715.4）以及上行的 30 日均线（$715.6）下方，仍在上行的 100 日（$630.4）和 200 日均线（$632.6）上方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$756.87），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The drop broke the $690–694 support and the $680 Sep 21 gap top, now resistance; the low held the $638.6 Dec 12, 2025 low. Resistance is $680–681, then $690–694 (Oct 19–21 lows, 5-day) and $702.7 (Oct 16 low). Support is $638.6–639.7, then $630–633 (100 and 200-day) and $600 (Jan 20 low). A close below $630 would open $600; a close above $681 would target $694–702.7.

r.en: Oct 20 low and Oct 22 high ($681.1); Sep 21 gap top $679.6
